title: [finding] platform-readings: a PR-body edit through the fleet relay stores the body byte-identical and appends no footer, unlike the bare-REST +58-byte reading
body:
**Class:** platform-fact change (handover-report category 3, `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈座位贴协议〉). Filed by `domain:devx` seat 2 (`session_018mA64scZ8fmpiPkrHVAwXj`, post #20163) at sign-off. It was recorded as "not yet filed" in that post's Notes.

**What the references say today.** `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` :345–:346 (改侧): a bare REST `PATCH /pulls` always appends one bare footer and keeps any existing footer, a delta of exactly 58 bytes. Re-sending reproduces it. :343 then derives the prescription: the create side sends the full block, and the edit side sends no footer.

**What this seat measured on a different transport.** Two PR-body edits on PR #20170 (2026-09-27) went through the **fleet relay** (`scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`, op `issue_patch` / PR-body edit, transport `dispatch`, written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`). Both stored bodies read back **byte-identical to what was sent**, and nothing was appended:
- Write 1 sent a body with no footer. The stored body matched it (md5 `1d90973b…`), with 0 bytes appended, so the PR body was left with no footer at all.
- Write 2 re-sent the body with its own `---` + footer block. The stored body matched it (md5 `6f36d778…`), and that is the current body of PR #20170.

**Why it matters.** The prescription at :343 ("the edit side sends no footer") is keyed to the action, not to the transport. On the relay it produces a PR body with NO footer at all, because nothing appends one. A seat following the line verbatim through the relay silently drops the attribution footer.

**Proposed one-line change:** split :345 by transport. Bare REST `PATCH` appends +58 bytes; a relay `issue_patch` / PR-body edit stores the body verbatim and appends nothing. So on the relay the edit side sends the full block, the same as the create side.

**Re-check:** after a relay PR-body edit, `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pulls/N` and compare `body` byte for byte with what was sent (`md5`); the delta is 0 on the relay.
